segments.name: Non-starters
segments.description: Registered but never opened the course materials in the course window. 88% withdraw; most never submit anything. The decision point is the first 10 days.

recommendations.content: Short 'first 15 minutes' onboarding module and a visible week-1 checklist.
recommendations.pacing: Soft-start deadline: first activity expected within 7 days of course start.
recommendations.support: Automated welcome sequence on day 1, 3 and 7; tutor call if still inactive on day 10; offer deferral.
recommendations.kpi: Share starting within 14 days; withdrawal before day 30.

segments.name: Consistent Achievers
segments.description: Study on ~40% of course days at an even pace, submit everything with a median 41 h to spare, complete ~76% of videos and post in forums. 90% pass, 22% with distinction.

recommendations.content: Advanced / extension content, recognition badges, pathways to next module.
recommendations.support: Recruit as peer mentors / forum moderators; minimal tutor time needed.
recommendations.kpi: Distinction rate, progression to next module.

segments.name: Last-minute Crammers
segments.description: Active on ~14% of days, with study concentrated on deadline days (3.4x the uniform rate) and bursty weeks; a quarter of work is submitted in the final 24 h (median lead time under 3 hours) and night logins are more common. They submit most work (89%) and score 58 on average: half pass, a third fail - the most 'movable' group.

recommendations.content: Break assessments into checkpoints; release practice quizzes 7-10 days before each deadline.
recommendations.pacing: Interim mini-deadlines and calendar nudges 5 and 2 days before deadlines (not at night).
recommendations.support: Study-plan coaching session on time management; peer accountability pairs.
recommendations.kpi: Last-minute submission share, deadline click ratio.

segments.name: At-risk Disengaged
segments.description: Started, then drifted away: active on ~3% of course days, last seen early (median recency 0.84 of the course), submit ~9% of assessments, median score 5/100. 65% withdraw, the rest fail — but they did start, so they can still be reached.

recommendations.content: Condensed 'catch-up path' covering assessed outcomes only; mobile-friendly micro lessons.
recommendations.pacing: Re-planned personal schedule with one achievable milestone per week; extension policy explained.
recommendations.support: Proactive tutor outreach call when recency > 14 days; refer to student-support services.
